# NEXUS CORE

> Free AI-built gold (XAUUSD) game plan: key zones, scenarios and the level that proves the view wrong, refreshed before the Asia, London and New York sessions, every plan graded in public.

NEXUS CORE AI publishes a free, AI-built trading plan for gold (XAUUSD) three times each trading day: before the Asia session (07:00 GMT+7), before London (13:45 GMT+7) and before New York (19:30 GMT+7). Each plan gives the bias, the main zone, targets, the level that invalidates the view, scenarios with rough probabilities, and the economic calendar. Every plan is graded in public on 15-minute candles after it expires: wins, losses and misses all stay on the record. Analysis only, not financial advice.

## Latest plan (2026-11-20, Asia plan, updated 2026-11-20 05:23 GMT+7)

- Permanent page: https://nexuscore.trade/en/plan/2026-11-20-asia/
- Bias: TWO-WAY, leaning SELL
- Summary: Two-way, leaning SELL on a bounce into 3655⁠–⁠3666 / 3684⁠–⁠3694; targets 3635 / 3620
- Main zone: SELL 3655–3666
- Target T1: 3619.9
- Target T2: 3600
- Target T3: 3590
- Target T4: 3558
- Target T5: 3550
- Expected range: 3570–3700
- View is wrong if: Main zone: an M15 close above 3669. Sell leg: an M15 close above 3687.3 → stop holding the short view, switch to a wide range, sell again only at 3717.7⁠–⁠3727.4 / 3731⁠–⁠3745 after a rejection; an H4 close above 3745 → room to rebound further to 3822.5. Breakdown leg: an M15 close back above 3635 after breaking 3619.9.
- Main scenario (~60%, SELL): Main (expected day shape): bounce, then drop: a sweep of 3600 / 3590 may come first; price bounces into 3655⁠–⁠3694, a rejection at 3655⁠–⁠3666 sends it back to 3635 / 3620; a further bounce to 3684⁠–⁠3694 is sold there, target 3666.
- Alternate scenario (~40%, SELL): Alternative: an M15 close more than 1 point below 3619.9 → stop waiting for the bounce, sell only on a pullback to the broken level, targets 3590 / 3558.
